::: {#exm-pearson-r}
#### Correlation between cholesterol and blood pressure in the WCGS

```{r}
#| label: cor-chol-sbp
cor(wcgs$chol, wcgs$sbp, use = "complete.obs")
```

The correlation is positive but small:
cholesterol tends to be slightly higher in participants with higher
systolic blood pressure,
consistent with the shallow slope and wide scatter
in @fig-scatter-chol-sbp.
:::
